additional_context: The linked Argonaut Zulip thread shows the original problem: a required BMI valueQuantity conflicted with using inline Observation.dataAbsentReason when the BMI value is absent. OO WGM minutes on 2024-09-25 confirm the approved motion to change valueQuantity cardinality to 0..1. Observation is active in source/fhir.ini and the Vital Signs implementation guide includes StructureDefinition/bmi, so the checked BMI profile XML is current build source.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current base Observation.value[x] is 0..1, the BMI profile value[x]:valueQuantity slice does not reintroduce min=1, and both the value slice and Observation.dataAbsentReason reference vsp-4, requiring either a value or dataAbsentReason for single vital-sign BMI observations.
